prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 93.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 87.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 31.3%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Clear Account Sync Warning on Sign In', 'Story Scroll Path Selector Redesign', 'Spotlight Pick Friend Persona Redesign', 'Split Screen Story Welcome Mascot Layout', 'Late Sign-In Conversion Reorder', 'Choose Path Compact Split Screen Layout', 'Live Asset Generation Stage Progress Indicator', 'Multi-Pet Account Retention Warning Copy', 'Two-Column Path Selection Layout', 'Post-Waiting Sign-In Journey Shift']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Split View Path Selection Redesign', 'Home Intro Desktop Controls Summary Copy', 'Photo Upload Guidelines and Sample Hints', 'Interactive Desktop Spawn Tips on Waiting Screen', 'Interactive Pet Selection Carousel', 'Adopt Before Account Sign-In Flow', 'Path Selector Visual Grid Layout', 'Interactive Generation Waiting Stage', 'Preset Style Fallback Flow for Custom Pet Creation', 'System Tray Spawn Guidance and Display Warning', 'Desktop Pet Quick Controls Guide Screen', 'Photo Quality Upload Assistant Hint', 'Centered Path Selection Choice Cards', 'Interactive Desktop Controls Checklist Screen', 'Sign-In Existing Pet Recovery Notice', 'Waiting Screen Ambient Sound and Stage Flow', 'Interactive Mascot Desktop Onboarding Overlay Screen', 'Sign-In Account Sync Guidance Hint', 'Desktop Spawn Notification Toggle', 'Interactive Welcome Story Intro Redesign', 'Desktop Spawn Ready Notification Toggle', 'Adopt First Account Sign-In Reorder', 'Waiting Screen Desktop Tip Carousel', 'Photo Quality Guidance Hint', 'Desktop Mascot Welcome & Controls Summary Redesign', 'Post-Adoption Sign-In Order Shift', 'Adoption Certificate Account Sync Protection Copy', 'Split Screen Path Selector with Story Preview', 'Interactive Pet Desktop Sandbox Screen', 'Stage Waiting Progress Redesign', 'Existing Account Pet Sync Warning Copy', 'Adoption Certificate Account Protection Hint', 'Home Intro Floating Companion Controls Redesign', 'Adoption Certificate Signature and Persona Redesign', 'Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Order Shift', 'Stage Layout Photo Validation Studio Redesign', 'Grid Layout Desktop Companion Overview Redesign', 'Real-Time Rendering Stage Time Estimator', 'Certificate Multi-Pet Backup Protection Copy', 'Desktop Tray Launch Notification Banner']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): none

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
(none yet)

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Account Recovery and Sign-In Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen to feature an account recovery and pet preservation notice directly above sign-in options to clarify that existing pets will sync.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep & Sync Your Pets
sign_in.body: Signing in ensures your desktop companions are safely saved to your account and synced across devices.

candidates.title: Interactive Persona & Customization Studio
candidates.change: Rebuild the pet pick screen into a stage studio layout where users customize pet personality traits and appearance preview side by side before confirming adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops significantly (69.9% conversion, median 89s) and users complain custom pet creation fails or looks wrong.

pick_friend.headline: Customize Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Adjust personality traits and preview your pet before completing adoption.

candidates.title: Desktop Preparation & Render Stage Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated stage screen setup during the waiting step showing live setup progress while pet assets generate.
candidates.why: Finish step drops to 64.8% and median waiting time is long (201s / 395s), with users unsure if the pet will show up on their desktop.

candidates.title: Desktop Quick Control Interactive Checklist
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro finish screen to a checklist layout detailing pet control shortcuts (hide, summon, talk).
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, and finish step conversion is 64.8%.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Live on Desktop!
home_intro.body: Learn these basic desktop shortcuts to interact with your new pet anytime.

components.text: Shortcut Guide: Alt+P to summon, Right-Click to hide, Double-Click to chat.

candidates.title: Card View Path Selection with Preview Badges
candidates.change: Change the choose_path screen layout to card layout with animated pet badges previewing each path choice.
candidates.why: Choose path has a mean time of 514s indicating some users hesitate when deciding their path.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Journey
choose_path.body: Pick how you want to create or adopt your desktop friend.

candidates.title: Photo Quality Live Validation Stage
candidates.change: Add real-time photo quality status badges and guidance inside the photo upload screen to prevent failed generations.
candidates.why: 3 support emails complained that custom pet generation fails or looks wrong during adoption.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Well-lit photos ensure your custom 3D desktop pet generates accurately.
upload_photos.hint: Ensure clear lighting and face visibility for optimal generation quality.

candidates.title: Desktop Overlay Permission & Ready Alert
candidates.change: Enable ready notifications and display clear desktop permission toggle during waiting stage.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pet does not show on desktop or app will not open when home screen finishes.

waiting.headline: Hatching Your Pet...
waiting.hint: Check your taskbar or notification center if your pet doesn't display immediately.

candidates.title: System Tray & Shortcut Hints on Intro Screen
candidates.change: Add persistent hint text explaining how to locate pet in the system tray and how to open pet settings.
candidates.why: Support emails cite post-onboarding confusion regarding controlling/hiding pets and desktop features misbehaving.

home_intro.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Sanctuary
home_intro.hint: Look for the pet icon in your taskbar system tray to toggle desktop overlay anytime.

candidates.title: Multi-Device Account Protection Copy
candidates.change: Update headline and body on sign_in screen emphasizing zero data loss and multi-device sync safety.
candidates.why: 8 emails specifically note pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Pets & Cloud Save
sign_in.body: Sign in now to back up your custom pets and preserve all progress across app restarts.
sign_in.hint: Already have an account? Sign in to restore your existing desktop pets.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Persona Confirmation Stamp
candidates.change: Add an official stamp badge component and celebration copy to the adoption certificate screen to boost completion.
candidates.why: Adoption step has high dropoff (69.9% conversion), so rewarding users at certificate signing increases completion motivation.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Congratulations! Your companion is officially registered and bound to your desktop.
